title: Day 11 Intelligence
subtitle: Rebecca Jollotta and perinatal behavioral-health care
one_liner: Jollotta supplied a sustained treatment account, with cross-examination testing symptom recognition, risk assessment, and medication choices.
purpose: Preserve the sequence and information basis of Jollotta's care without converting contested clinical judgment into canonical fact.
what_changed: The record gained a concentrated account of several weeks of perinatal psychiatric care and a detailed challenge to how symptoms and medication decisions were understood.
